behaviors.description: Explicit, NULL and empty install subsets.
expected: Explicit /bin excludes subset-control/payload; NULL and empty arrays deploy both files in separate installations.
Each fresh /bin-only deployment gains subset-control/payload with either { NULL } or { empty-string, NULL }.

behaviors.description: NULL updates merge retained and configured locales.
expected: Explicit ja excludes fr/de/es; NULL update adds configured fr, then configured de, retaining previous locales and excluding es.

behaviors.description: Related locale suppression and enabled control.
preconditions: Prepared selection app with suggested locale
expected: Disabled case resolves and deploys only app/runtime; enabled case includes locale, with exact prepared commits.

behaviors.description: Public custom-path dependency installation avoids runtime duplication.
preconditions: Isolated source with installed runtime and two empty targets
expected: Registered source omits target runtime operation and deployment; unregistered control installs runtime; source remains unchanged.

behaviors.description: Install directly from local repository URI.
expected: Native add_install accepts file URI, deploys exact commit, and installed origin resolves to a remote with that URI.

behaviors.description: Install, update, uninstall and bundle operation identity.
preconditions: Prepared query A/B repositories and plain bundle
expected: Ready getters identify exact requested ref/type and applicable origin; bundle getter is NULL or supplied GFile; current operation equals executing callback operation; exact resulting commits and uninstall absence.

mappings.rationale: Native add_install in three independent custom-path installations receives explicit /bin, NULL, and { NULL }. Public deploy-dir file observations distinguish requested and excluded prepared payloads; exact commit checks accompany every variant.
Two independently installed /bin subsets exclude subset-control/payload before native add_update; { NULL } and { empty-string, NULL } each deploy both payloads at the prepared commit.

Explicit ja-only initial install excludes configured fr. NULL native updates add fr then de while retaining ja and previous fr, with es absent throughout. Public deploy-dir files have independently prepared language contents.
Set disable_related both TRUE and FALSE on independent transactions. Exact operation and installed-ref sets exclude/include suggested locale while retaining required runtime; verify prepared commits.

Public new_for_path creates isolated user source and targets. Native add_dependency_source with installed runtime removes runtime from resolved operations and target enumeration; omission control installs second runtime. Source enumeration and exact commit remain unchanged.

Native add_install receives prepared file URI in empty installation without remote setup. Exact installed commit and public origin getter followed by remote lookup/URL verify the created source remote without assuming its generated name.

Native install/update/uninstall/bundle-install requests yield exact requested ref and enum type, applicable origin and nullable bundle GFile. Each execution callback compares owned get_current_operation pointer to its operation argument. Independent commit expectations and uninstall absence verify execution.
